'''Christian Kriesel''' (also published as '''Chris Kriesel'''; DeckTech handle '''dannik''') is a Star Wars CCG player who finished 30th at [[2001 Normal DPC]] on 24 February 2001, according to Michael Raveling's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1814">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-27-normal-2001d1814/ normal-2001], DeckTech (Michael "Gilliatt" Raveling, 27 February 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-27-normal-2001d1814/ GitHub Pages].</ref> He posted a [[Dark]] [[Court Of The Vile Gangster / I Shall Enjoy Watching You Die|Court Of The Vile Gangster]] list on DeckTech in April 2001.<ref name="dt-15545">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/15545 Vile Gangster Done different], DeckTech (chris "dannik" kriesel, 23 April 2001). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/15545/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/15545/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
